capabilities: open HTML and MHTML files in sandboxed iframes
run JavaScript inside the file view
zoom, search, and full-screen the rendered page
toggle dark/light mode or keep original colors
auto-reload when the file changes on disk
extras: Manifest note: 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.'
problem: Obsidian cannot open HTML files directly; clicking them fails or gives a degraded view without scripts or controls.
summary: Viewer that opens .html, .htm, and .mht/.mhtml files in Obsidian inside sandboxed iframes with JavaScript, zoom, search, and theme controls.
